title: Directs the Department of Transportation to study issues related to improving ground transportation infrastructure resilience and to report to an appropriate committee or interim committee of the Legislative Assembly on or before September 15, 2026.

claims.text: HB 3301 was introduced in the House on January 21, 2025.
